beats.say: One kind of electric eel can hit eight hundred sixty volts.
It hunts in the muddy rivers of the Amazon.
First, a secret. It isn't actually an eel.
It's a knifefish, closer to catfish than to eels.
And it grows up to eight feet long.
Most of that body is packed with electric organs.
It even breathes air, so it pops up to gulp it.
Threaten it, and it leaps out of the water at you.
Not an eel. Still a shock.
